I want: the system to receive structured invoice data from the existing extraction pipeline
So that: there is no duplicate data entry or parallel extraction process
Acceptance Criteria: System consumes invoice data via the existing API without modification to the extraction layer

I want: the system to handle invoices with multiple line items
So that: each line is coded correctly rather than applying one code to the whole invoice
Acceptance Criteria: System processes each line independently and produces separate predictions

I want: the system to handle invoices in multiple currencies
So that: amount comparisons are accurate regardless of currency
Acceptance Criteria: System normalizes amounts to a base currency for retrieval and comparison

I want: the system to handle invoices across multiple legal entities without mixing data
So that: entity A invoices do not influence predictions for entity B
Acceptance Criteria: Retrieval is filtered by entity ID; cross-entity data leakage is zero

I want: the system to identify and process only non-PO invoices
So that: PO invoices continue to flow through the existing matching workflow
Acceptance Criteria: System checks for PO reference and routes PO invoices to existing matching engine

I want: the system to handle invoices where the vendor name varies slightly
So that: minor spelling differences do not prevent processing
Acceptance Criteria: Fuzzy matching resolves vendor names with confidence above 0.85

I want: the system to flag invoices with missing or incomplete data
So that: I am not asked to review a prediction based on bad input
Acceptance Criteria: Invoices with missing vendor, amount, or description route to review with reason code

I want: the system to handle handwritten notes without confusion
So that: annotations do not corrupt the prediction
Acceptance Criteria: OCR noise filtering removes handwritten elements before embedding

I want: the system to handle credit notes as distinct from standard invoices
So that: credit notes are not coded as regular purchases
Acceptance Criteria: Credit notes are identified and routed to appropriate coding logic

I want: the system to handle recurring invoices differently from one-off invoices
So that: recurring patterns are recognised and processed faster
Acceptance Criteria: Recurring invoices are tagged and retrieved with higher weight for pattern matching

I want: the system to resolve raw vendor names to a canonical identity
So that: invoices from the same vendor are treated consistently
Acceptance Criteria: MDM match rate exceeds 95 percent for top 500 vendors

I want: the system to handle vendor name variations and aliases
So that: invoices from trading names reach the correct vendor record
Acceptance Criteria: Alias table covers known trading names and abbreviations

I want: the system to handle vendor acquisitions where the legal name changed
So that: post-acquisition invoices match the original vendor identity
Acceptance Criteria: Acquisition mappings are maintained in MDM with effective dates

I want: the system to flag invoices where vendor resolution fails

Acceptance Criteria: Low MDM confidence triggers review with reason code

I want: the system to prevent cross-entity vendor confusion
So that: similar vendor names in different entities do not collide
Acceptance Criteria: Entity prefix or isolation prevents cross-entity matching

I want: the system to maintain a master vendor record separate from coding prediction
So that: vendor data is managed independently
Acceptance Criteria: MDM service is distinct from the prediction service

I want: the system to handle new vendors not in the master record
So that: new suppliers are processed without blocking the workflow
Acceptance Criteria: New vendors route to review with flag for MDM registration

I want: the system to match subsidiary invoices to parent company where appropriate
So that: subsidiary coding follows parent patterns
Acceptance Criteria: Parent-subsidiary hierarchy is respected in retrieval filtering

I want: the system to predict general ledger account codes for non-PO lines

Acceptance Criteria: GL account prediction accuracy exceeds baseline within 90 days

I want: the system to predict cost centre codes for non-PO lines

Acceptance Criteria: Cost centre prediction accuracy exceeds baseline within 90 days

I want: the system to predict tax codes for non-PO lines

Acceptance Criteria: Tax code prediction accuracy exceeds baseline within 90 days

I want: the system to handle invoices requiring multiple coding rows

I want: the system to handle fixed amount splits across multiple GL accounts

Acceptance Criteria: Fixed amount splits are predicted when historical pattern supports it

I want: the system to predict coding based on historical patterns for the same vendor

I want: the system to predict coding based on similar line descriptions

I want: the system to predict coding based on amount bands and thresholds

I want: the system to predict coding based on the legal entity chart of accounts

I want: the system to show the evidence that supports every prediction

I want: the system to handle seasonal or periodic patterns
